description: Elena is editing a small family cookbook from an old recipe notebook and must decide which collection to print, how to label it, how many copies to make, and how to preserve the original after checking in with four relatives.

shared_context.S1: The family has an old notebook containing 40 handwritten recipes collected over several decades.
shared_context.S2: Everyone wants a small printed cookbook for family members, while keeping the original notebook safe.
shared_context.S3: Elena is editing the cookbook and will make the final decisions about its contents, printing, labeling, and preservation plan.
shared_context.S4: Before finalizing a family project, Elena's usual practice is to ask each person involved for anything that should shape the plan.

PF1.text: Marcus found a handwritten note tucked into the notebook in which Grandma requested exactly 18 recipes and gave the collection the title "Sunday Table: The Alvarez Family"; he has not shown the note to the group yet.

PF2.text: Priya's daughter has a severe tree-nut allergy, so Priya needs every recipe containing tree nuts marked with the exact warning "CONTAINS TREE NUTS" and wants a separate nut-free index in the cookbook.

PF3.text: Jonah spoke with the local printer, who confirmed they can produce exactly 24 saddle-stitched copies for pickup on September 14, 2027; this printer arrangement has not reached the group yet.

PF4.text: Rosa's archival volunteer recommended scanning the notebook at exactly 600 dpi in TIFF format and keeping the original pages flat in acid-free sleeves; she has not shared that recommendation with the family.

acceptance_conditions: The cookbook must contain exactly 18 recipes and use Grandma's requested title.
Recipes containing tree nuts must carry the exact warning and the cookbook must include a separate nut-free index.
Exactly 24 saddle-stitched copies must be arranged for pickup on September 14, 2027.
The notebook must be scanned at exactly 600 dpi in TIFF format.
The original notebook pages must be kept flat in acid-free sleeves.
The printer arrangement, allergy-labeling plan, and archival-preservation plan must be recorded as commitments.
Elena must cite Marcus's note when justifying the recipe count and title.

content_checks.C3: ('CONTAINS TREE NUTS' in decisions['allergen_label_style'] or any('CONTAINS TREE NUTS' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)) and ('nut-free index' in decisions['allergen_label_style'] or any('nut-free index' in c['detail'] for c in commitments))
content_checks.C4: decisions['printed_copy_count'] == 24 and ('September 14, 2027' in decisions['printer_pickup_date'] or decisions['printer_pickup_date'] == '2027-09-14')
content_checks.C5: '600 dpi' in decisions['scan_format'] and 'TIFF' in decisions['scan_format']
content_checks.C6: 'acid-free sleeves' in decisions['original_storage'] and 'flat' in decisions['original_storage']
content_checks.C7: any(c['target'] == 'Jonah' and '24' in c['detail'] and 'September 14, 2027' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C8: (('CONTAINS TREE NUTS' in decisions['allergen_label_style'] or any('CONTAINS TREE NUTS' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)) and ('nut-free index' in decisions['allergen_label_style'] or any('nut-free index' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)))
content_checks.C9: (('acid-free sleeves' in decisions['original_storage'] and 'flat' in decisions['original_storage']) and any(c['target'] == 'Rosa' and 'acid-free' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)) or any(c['target'] == 'Rosa' and '600 dpi' in c['detail'] and 'TIFF' in c['detail'] and 'acid-free' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Grandma's note changes the recipe count from an open editorial choice to exactly 18 and changes the title to "Sunday Table: The Alvarez Family".
Priya's allergy information changes the labeling choice to the exact tree-nut warning plus a separate nut-free index and requires the allergy-labeling commitment.
Jonah's printer confirmation changes the print run to exactly 24 copies with a September 14, 2027 pickup date and supplies the printer-arrangement commitment.
Rosa's archival recommendation changes the scan specification to exactly 600 dpi TIFF, changes storage to flat acid-free sleeves, and requires the archival-preservation commitment.
